description: Source code for ARC4 encryption driver in Linux kernel, implementing hardware-accelerated ARC4 cipher with registration and unregistration functions, key setup, and encryption/decryption routines.

methods.name: arc4_set_key
methods.description: Sets the ARC4 encryption key, configuring hardware registers with key bytes.

methods.name: arc4_set_key_skcipher
methods.description: Wrapper for setting ARC4 key via skcipher context.

methods.name: _deu_arc4
methods.description: Main interface to hardware for encrypting/decrypting data using ARC4.

methods.name: ecb_arc4_encrypt
methods.description: Performs ECB mode encryption using Linux skcipher API.

methods.name: ecb_arc4_decrypt
methods.description: Performs ECB mode decryption using Linux skcipher API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_arc4
methods.description: Registers ARC4 cipher algorithms and initializes hardware.
